summary: Enhance your corporate governance skills with our training on the vital role of audit committees. Learn best practices and improve oversight effectiveness.
lede: Board audit committee training prepares committee members, directors, and governance professionals to assess financial reporting, controls, and organizational risk. Participants learn to analyze financial statements and accounting judgments, evaluate internal control design and effectiveness, and compare risk appetite with reported exposure. They also develop approaches to auditor oversight and ethics and whistleblower programs to support informed committee decisions.
audienceIntro: This course serves audit committee members, governance professionals, and senior executives responsible for supporting or enhancing audit committee effectiveness across all sectors and organizational structures.
audience: Chief Financial Officers and Finance Leaders
modules: Audit Committee Foundation and Regulatory Landscape
Financial Reporting Quality Assessment and Analysis
Internal Control Environment Evaluation and Oversight
Enterprise Risk Management Integration and Oversight
External Auditor Selection, Management, and Evaluation
Internal Audit Function Oversight and Coordination
Ethics Program Oversight and Whistleblower Management
Regulatory Compliance and Legal Risk Oversight
Committee Operations Excellence and Stakeholder Engagement
Performance Measurement, Governance Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required. Participants should have basic understanding of financial statements and corporate governance concepts. Prior board or committee experience helpful but not essential. Course materials include relevant regulatory references and governance frameworks for international application.
